fluff.overview: The Blessed Order maintained conventional infantry formations equipped with preserved Star League-era weapons and personal armor, fielding platoons that were better armed than most Successor State infantry throughout the late Succession Wars. Motorized platoons use light vehicles to achieve ground speeds well beyond foot infantry, allowing rapid redeployment between defensive positions. Their wheeled or motorcycle transport keeps the formation mobile on developed road networks, though off-road performance is limited. Armed with man-portable flamers that project streams of ignited fuel, these troops carry one of the most psychologically devastating weapons available to conventional infantry, effective at clearing fortified positions and enclosed spaces at the cost of extreme danger to the operator.
